prompt_text:
Continue the given text:
Your entire life, you've been told you're deathly allergic to bees. You've always had people protecting you from them, be it your mother or a hired hand. Today, one slips through and lands on your shoulder. You hear a tiny voice say "Your Majesty, what are your orders?"

The voice is coming from the bee! You frantically flip through your mental notes of all the things you've learned about bees. You always knew they had a hive mind, but you didn't know that they could talk! You quickly reason that you should try and get it off of you before it stings you. You reach for the bee, hoping to pick it up and move it off your shoulder. 

You grab the bee, and it stings you on your exposed wrist.
reference_text: You feel a sharp pain, and a pinch, unlike any you've ever felt before. Suddenly, you're aware of the entire hive's thoughts. You know what everyone is doing, and you are given the ability to control every bee in the hive. The only thing you can't feel is your own body...

instruction.label: exactly once
instruction.rule: At least one tracked phrase ('pinch', 'unlike', 'sharp', 'aware', 'pain', 'thoughts', 'ability', 'body', 'control', 'given', 'felt', 'ever', 'thing', 'every', 'everyone', 'feel', 'any') must occur exactly once.
